digest.component_or_area: Claude Code settings and MCP tool configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction versus cheaper always-loaded alternatives like Bash
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only control lever available and is all-or-nothing global (no per-tool or per-server granularity), making selective non-deferral of Serena tools alone impossible
Loading all Serena tool schemas costs ~25k minimum tokens and up to 64k on hosts with multiple MCP servers connected, but the change is reversible via a single JSON key deletion
A tracked .claude/settings.json with .gitignore negation can ship the ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false setting while keeping the rest of .claude/ operator-local
